passages.text: And Elihu continued: “Bear with me a little longer, and I will show you that there is more to be said on God’s behalf.
passages.sermon:
Elihu spoke again.
He said, "Please listen to me a little longer.
I have more to say about God.
I will show you more about Him."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥סֶף אֱלִיה֗וּא וַיֹּאמַֽר׃ כַּתַּר־ לִ֣י זְ֭עֵיר וַאֲחַוֶּ֑ךָּ כִּ֤י ע֖וֹד לֶאֱל֣וֹהַּ מִלִּֽים׃

passages.text: I get my knowledge from afar, and I will ascribe justice to my Maker.
passages.sermon:
Elihu speaks.
Elihu is a young man.
Elihu claims wisdom.
Elihu says, “I get my knowledge from afar.”
Elihu says, “I will give justice to my Maker.”
passages.original: אֶשָּׂ֣א דֵ֭עִי לְמֵרָח֑וֹק וּ֝לְפֹעֲלִ֗י אֶֽתֵּֽן־ צֶֽדֶק׃

passages.text: For truly my words are free of falsehood; one perfect in knowledge is with you.
passages.sermon:
Elihu is speaking.
Elihu says his words are true.
Elihu says his words do not contain lies.
Elihu says someone perfect in knowledge is present with you.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ אָ֭מְנָם לֹא־ שֶׁ֣קֶר מִלָּ֑י תְּמִ֖ים דֵּע֣וֹת עִמָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: Indeed, God is mighty, but He despises no one; He is mighty in strength of understanding.
passages.sermon:
God is mighty.
God does not despise anyone.
God has great strength.
God has great understanding.
passages.original: הֶן־ אֵ֣ל כַּ֭בִּיר וְלֹ֣א יִמְאָ֑ס כַּ֝בִּ֗יר כֹּ֣חַֽ לֵֽב׃

passages.text: He does not keep the wicked alive, but He grants justice to the afflicted.
passages.sermon: God is mighty.\r\nGod does not let the wicked live.\r\nGod gives justice to the afflicted.
passages.original: לֹא־ יְחַיֶּ֥ה רָשָׁ֑ע וּמִשְׁפַּ֖ט עֲנִיִּ֣ים יִתֵּֽן׃

passages.text: He does not take His eyes off the righteous, but He enthrones them with kings and exalts them forever.
passages.sermon:
God is mighty.
God does not despise anyone.
God is mighty in strength and understanding.
God does not take His eyes off the righteous.
God places the righteous with kings on thrones.
God exalts the righteous forever.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ יִגְרַ֥ע מִצַּדִּ֗יק עֵ֫ינָ֥יו וְאֶת־ מְלָכִ֥ים לַכִּסֵּ֑א וַיֹּשִׁיבֵ֥ם לָ֝נֶ֗צַח וַיִּגְבָּֽהוּ׃

passages.text: And if men are bound with chains, caught in cords of affliction, then He tells them their deeds and how arrogantly they have transgressed.
passages.sermon:
God is just and powerful.
Sometimes, people are bound with chains.
They are caught in cords of affliction.
God tells them what they have done.
He shows them their deeds.
He reveals their transgressions.
He shows them how they acted arrogantly.
passages.original: וְאִם־ אֲסוּרִ֥ים בַּזִּקִּ֑ים יִ֝לָּכְד֗וּן בְּחַבְלֵי־ עֹֽנִי׃ וַיַּגֵּ֣ד לָהֶ֣ם פָּעֳלָ֑ם וּ֝פִשְׁעֵיהֶ֗ם כִּ֣י יִתְגַּבָּֽרוּ׃

passages.text: He opens their ears to correction and commands that they turn from iniquity.
passages.sermon: God acts with wisdom and authority.\r\nGod opens their ears to correction.\r\nGod commands them to turn from iniquity.
passages.original: וַיִּ֣גֶל אָ֭זְנָם לַמּוּסָ֑ר וַ֝יֹּ֗אמֶר כִּֽי־ יְשֻׁב֥וּן מֵאָֽוֶן׃

passages.text: If they obey and serve Him, then they end their days in prosperity and their years in happiness.
passages.sermon:
God watches over people.
He gives commands.
If people obey God, they listen to His voice.
If people serve God, they do what He asks.
God rewards those who obey and serve Him.
They finish their days in prosperity.
They spend their years in happiness.
passages.original: אִֽם־ יִשְׁמְע֗וּ וְֽיַ֫עֲבֹ֥דוּ יְכַלּ֣וּ יְמֵיהֶ֣ם בַּטּ֑וֹב וּ֝שְׁנֵיהֶ֗ם בַּנְּעִימִֽים׃

passages.text: But if they do not obey, then they perish by the sword and die without knowledge.
passages.sermon:
God gives people correction.
God commands people to turn from iniquity.
If people do not obey God, they face consequences.
They perish by the sword.
They die without knowledge.
passages.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁמְעוּ בְּשֶׁ֣לַח יַעֲבֹ֑רוּ וְ֝יִגְוְע֗וּ כִּבְלִי־ דָֽעַת׃

passages.text: The godless in heart harbor resentment; even when He binds them, they do not cry for help.
passages.sermon:
The godless in heart feel resentment.
They do not turn to God for help.
God binds them.
Even then, they do not cry out to Him.
passages.original: וְֽחַנְפֵי־ לֵ֭ב יָשִׂ֣ימוּ אָ֑ף לֹ֥א יְ֝שַׁוְּע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲסָרָֽם׃

passages.text: They die in their youth, among the male shrine prostitutes.
passages.sermon: The godless in heart die young.\r\nThey die while they are still in their youth.\r\nThey die among male shrine prostitutes.
passages.original: תָּמֹ֣ת בַּנֹּ֣עַר נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְ֝חַיָּתָ֗ם בַּקְּדֵשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: God rescues the afflicted by their affliction and opens their ears in oppression.
passages.sermon:
God helps people who suffer.
He uses their suffering to rescue them.
God speaks to people when they are oppressed.
He opens their ears during times of trouble.
passages.original: יְחַלֵּ֣ץ עָנִ֣י בְעָנְי֑וֹ וְיִ֖גֶל בַּלַּ֣חַץ אָזְנָֽם׃

passages.text: Indeed, He drew you from the jaws of distress to a spacious and broad place, to a table full of richness.
passages.sermon:
God acted for you.
God rescued you from great distress.
God brought you out of trouble.
God placed you in a wide and open place.
God gave you safety and freedom.
God set a table before you.
Your table is full of good things.
God provided you with abundance.
passages.original: וְאַ֤ף הֲסִיתְךָ֨׀ מִפִּי־ צָ֗ר רַ֭חַב לֹא־ מוּצָ֣ק תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ וְנַ֥חַת שֻׁ֝לְחָנְךָ֗ מָ֣לֵא דָֽשֶׁן׃

passages.text: But now you are laden with the judgment due the wicked; judgment and justice have seized you.
passages.sermon: You carry the judgment that belongs to the wicked.\r\nJudgment holds you now.\r\nJustice holds you now.
passages.original: וְדִין־ רָשָׁ֥ע מָלֵ֑אתָ דִּ֖ין וּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט יִתְמֹֽכוּ׃

passages.text: Be careful that no one lures you with riches; do not let a large bribe lead you astray.
passages.sermon:
This passage warns you.
It warns you about anger.
Anger can tempt you.
Do not let anger lead you into doubt.
Do not let anyone tempt you with riches.
Do not let a large bribe turn you away from what is right.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ חֵ֭מָה פֶּן־ יְסִֽיתְךָ֣ בְסָ֑פֶק וְרָב־ כֹּ֝֗פֶר אַל־ יַטֶּֽךָּ׃

passages.text: Can your wealth or all your mighty effort keep you from distress?
passages.sermon:
Wealth cannot save you from trouble.
Your riches cannot protect you from distress.
Your strength cannot keep you safe.
All your efforts cannot rescue you from hardship.
No amount of power can deliver you from suffering.
passages.original: הֲיַעֲרֹ֣ךְ שׁ֭וּעֲךָ לֹ֣א בְצָ֑ר וְ֝כֹ֗ל מַאֲמַצֵּי־ כֹֽחַ׃

passages.text: Do not long for the night, when people vanish from their homes.
passages.sermon:
Do not desire the night.
The night is a time when people disappear from their homes.
Do not wish for such a time.
Do not hope for darkness to come.
Do not seek a time when others are taken away.
passages.original: אַל־ תִּשְׁאַ֥ף הַלָּ֑יְלָה לַעֲל֖וֹת עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם׃

passages.text: Be careful not to turn to iniquity, for this you have preferred to affliction.
passages.sermon:
Be careful.
Do not turn to sin.
You have chosen sin instead of suffering.
passages.original: הִ֭שָּׁמֶר אַל־ תֵּ֣פֶן אֶל־ אָ֑וֶן כִּֽי־ עַל־ זֶ֝֗ה בָּחַ֥רְתָּ מֵעֹֽנִי׃

passages.text: Behold, God is exalted in His power. Who is a teacher like Him?
passages.sermon: God is exalted in His power.\r\nNo one is a teacher like God.
passages.original: הֶן־ אֵ֭ל יַשְׂגִּ֣יב בְּכֹח֑וֹ מִ֖י כָמֹ֣הוּ מוֹרֶֽה׃

passages.text: Who has appointed His way for Him, or told Him, ‘You have done wrong’?
passages.sermon:
God is exalted in power.
No one can direct God's path.
No one can appoint God's way for Him.
No one can say to God, "You have done wrong."
passages.original: מִֽי־ פָקַ֣ד עָלָ֣יו דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּמִֽי־ אָ֝מַ֗ר פָּעַ֥לְתָּ עַוְלָֽה׃

passages.text: Remember to magnify His work, which men have praised in song.
passages.sermon:
God is powerful and great.
People have praised God's works in songs.
Remember to honor God's works.
Magnify what God has done.
passages.original: זְ֭כֹר כִּֽי־ תַשְׂגִּ֣יא פָעֳל֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר שֹׁרְר֣וּ אֲנָשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: All mankind has seen it; men behold it from afar.
passages.sermon: All people have seen God's work.\r\nEvery person looks at it from far away.
passages.original: כָּל־ אָדָ֥ם חָֽזוּ־ ב֑וֹ אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ יַבִּ֥יט מֵרָחֽוֹק׃

passages.text: Indeed, God is great—beyond our knowledge; the number of His years is unsearchable.
passages.sermon:
God is great.
We cannot fully know God.
God’s greatness is beyond our understanding.
No one can count the years of God’s life.
God’s years have no limit.
No one can search out the number of His years.
passages.original: הֶן־ אֵ֣ל שַׂ֭גִּיא וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע מִסְפַּ֖ר שָׁנָ֣יו וְלֹא־ חֵֽקֶר׃

passages.text: For He draws up drops of water which distill the rain from the mist, which the clouds pour out and shower abundantly on mankind.
passages.sermon:
God acts with great power.
God draws up drops of water from the earth.
God turns these drops into mist.
God makes rain from the mist.
Clouds carry the rain.
Clouds pour out the rain.
The rain falls on many people.
God provides rain for all mankind.
passages.original: כִּ֭י יְגָרַ֣ע נִטְפֵי־ מָ֑יִם יָזֹ֖קּוּ מָטָ֣ר לְאֵדֽוֹ׃ אֲשֶֽׁר־ יִזְּל֥וּ שְׁחָקִ֑ים יִ֝רְעֲפ֗וּ עֲלֵ֤י׀ אָדָ֬ם רָֽב׃

passages.text: Furthermore, who can understand how the clouds spread out, how the thunder roars from His pavilion?
passages.sermon:
God is great.
God is beyond our knowledge.
No one can fully understand God.
No one can understand how God spreads out the clouds.
No one can understand how thunder comes from God's dwelling place.
God's ways are mysterious.
God controls the clouds and the thunder.
passages.original: אַ֣ף אִם־ יָ֭בִין מִפְרְשֵׂי־ עָ֑ב תְּ֝שֻׁא֗וֹת סֻכָּתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: See how He scatters His lightning around Him and covers the depths of the sea.
passages.sermon: God scatters His lightning around Himself.\r\nGod covers the depths of the sea.
passages.original: הֵן־ פָּרַ֣שׂ עָלָ֣יו אוֹר֑וֹ וְשָׁרְשֵׁ֖י הַיָּ֣ם כִּסָּֽה׃

passages.text: For by these He judges the nations and provides food in abundance.
passages.sermon: God uses the clouds and storms to act.\r\nHe judges all nations by these things.\r\nHe gives food in great abundance through them.
passages.original: כִּי־ בָ֭ם יָדִ֣ין עַמִּ֑ים יִֽתֶּן־ אֹ֥כֶל לְמַכְבִּֽיר׃

passages.text: He fills His hands with lightning and commands it to strike its mark.
passages.sermon:
God acts with great power.
God fills His hands with lightning.
God commands the lightning.
The lightning strikes where God sends it.
passages.original: עַל־ כַּפַּ֥יִם כִּסָּה־ א֑וֹר וַיְצַ֖ו עָלֶ֣יהָ בְמַפְגִּֽיעַ׃

passages.text: The thunder declares His presence; even the cattle regard the rising storm.
passages.sermon: Thunder shows God’s presence.\r\nCattle notice the coming storm.
passages.original: יַגִּ֣יד עָלָ֣יו רֵע֑וֹ מִ֝קְנֶ֗ה אַ֣ף עַל־ עוֹלֶֽה׃
